description: Duplicate items with an offset, as Alt/Option-dragging or nudging with the duplicate modifier does, or make several copies at a fixed offset, optionally as a grid (Edit > Step and Repeat). The copies are made as one undoable step by default (script undo mode)

columns.description: For step_and_repeat as a grid: columns (dx is the horizontal step)

count.description: For step_and_repeat: number of copies (ignored when rows or columns is given)

direction.description: For nudge: the arrow key direction

factor.description: For nudge: the keyboard increment, ten times it (Shift) or a tenth of it

mode.description: offset: one copy moved by dx/dy; nudge: one copy moved by the keyboard increment; step_and_repeat: count copies, or a rows x columns grid

rows.description: For step_and_repeat as a grid: rows (dy is the vertical step)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

undoMode.description: How the copies are recorded for Undo: entire_script (one step), fast_entire_script (one step, faster, no partial undo), auto_undo (merged into the previous step), script_request (each copy is its own step)

name: step_and_repeat_items
title: Step And Repeat Items
